title: Full metrics recording with outcome labeling
description: Extend AnalyticsCollector to record the full metrics_timeseries field set and compute 7-day outcome labels (breakout/hit/neutral/flop/banned) based on configurable thresholds. Outcome labels feed the Feedback Curator.
sub_tasks: Define OutcomeLabel enum (breakout, hit, neutral, flop, banned)
Define OutcomeThresholds config with defaults from SPEC
Add record_full_metrics() to AnalyticsCollector with all timeseries fields
Unit tests for outcome labeling edge cases
